entries.short_description: Register handler when game world is fully loaded and all globals available
entries.plain_english_meaning: Run this code once when the game starts - all vanilla classes exist by this time
entries.why_it_matters: Primary initialization hook. Monkey-patches MUST be deferred to this event.
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR uses this correctly in 15+ files for patch initialization
entries.notes: Always guard: if Events and Events.OnGameStart then

entries.short_description: Hook into right-click context menu for world objects
entries.plain_english_meaning: When player right-clicks something in the world, add custom menu options
entries.why_it_matters: Primary way mods add interactive options to world objects
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR's central context menu hub uses this
entries.notes: Callback signature: function(playerNum, context, worldobjects, test)

entries.short_description: Server-side handler for client commands
entries.plain_english_meaning: When a client sends a command to the server, this handler processes it
entries.why_it_matters: ALL multiplayer-safe state changes must go through this pattern
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR_ServerCommands uses a single handler for all 20+ commands
entries.notes: Callback: function(module, command, player, args). Always validate module match first.
entries.example_snippet_summary: Events.OnClientCommand.Add(function(mod,cmd,player,args) if mod ~= 'MyMod' then return end ... end)

entries.file_path: 22 CSR TimedAction files, SaucedCarts, VehicleSafety, WaterPipes
entries.short_description: Create custom timed action class
entries.plain_english_meaning: Define a new type of timed action that players can perform
entries.why_it_matters: Foundation of all player interactions in PZ mods
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has 22 custom timed action classes
entries.notes: In perform(), MUST call ISBaseTimedAction.perform(self) at end

entries.file_path: CSR_ContextMenu.lua, all ref mods with actions
entries.short_description: Queue a timed action for execution
entries.plain_english_meaning: Add an action to the player's queue - it will run after current actions finish
entries.why_it_matters: FIFO queue - add transfers before dependent actions
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used 30+ times across CSR
entries.notes: B42.15 fix: JeevesPatches removed pcall wrapper that corrupted Kahlua stack

entries.short_description: Transfer item to player inventory if needed before action
entries.plain_english_meaning: If the item isn't already in the player's hands, move it there first
entries.why_it_matters: PREFERRED transfer method - handles container walking automatically
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR uses this correctly in queueActionAfterTransfers
entries.notes: CSR_ProximityLoot uses ISInventoryTransferUtil instead - INCONSISTENT

entries.short_description: Direct transfer action creation with 4 parameters
entries.plain_english_meaning: Create a transfer action to move an item from one container to another
entries.why_it_matters: Direct API usage - works but transferIfNeeded is preferred
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used in TransferAmount for grab/put amount features
entries.notes: Params: player, item, sourceContainer, destContainer

entries.short_description: Utility wrapper for transfer action creation
entries.plain_english_meaning: Create a transfer action using the utility wrapper (may not always be loaded)
entries.why_it_matters: POTENTIALLY OUTDATED - different API than rest of CSR project
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CRITICAL: Only file using this pattern - inconsistent with project
entries.notes: Should be standardized to match CSR_TransferAmount pattern

entries.short_description: Find first item of given type in inventory
entries.plain_english_meaning: Search player's inventory for a specific item type and return it
entries.why_it_matters: Used to check tool availability (crowbar, screwdriver, etc.)
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used extensively for tool checks in context menus and server commands
entries.notes: Returns nil if not found - always nil-check result

entries.short_description: Server-side inventory manipulation
entries.plain_english_meaning: Remove or add items from containers on the server
entries.why_it_matters: Server-authoritative inventory changes for MP
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR_ServerCommands does all adds/removes server-side
entries.notes: MUST validate item existence before removal; validate player distance before adding

entries.short_description: Get world square from coordinates
entries.plain_english_meaning: Look up a tile/square in the game world by its X, Y, Z position
entries.why_it_matters: Foundation of all world object interaction on server side
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used in ServerCommands for resolving client-sent coordinates
entries.notes: ALWAYS nil-check result - square may be unloaded. CSR doesn't type-validate coords from client.

entries.short_description: Get position index of object on its square
entries.plain_english_meaning: Get the numerical position of this object in the square's object list
entries.why_it_matters: Used for server-side object resolution - indices change when objects are modified
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR sends objectIndex from client to server for target resolution
entries.notes: SYNC-SENSITIVE: Index can change between client action start and server processing

entries.short_description: Remove object from square and sync to all clients
entries.plain_english_meaning: Remove a world object and tell all connected players about it
entries.why_it_matters: Required for MP-visible world object removal
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used in standpipe object replacement and ground cleanup
entries.notes: Must be called from server or will only affect local client

entries.short_description: Sync vehicle door state to server/clients
entries.plain_english_meaning: Tell everyone that this vehicle door changed state (locked/unlocked)
entries.why_it_matters: Required after toggleLockedDoor for MP visibility
entries.relevance_to_current_project: Used in vehicle pry/lockpick system
entries.notes: sendVars() should only be called on server side

entries.file_path: 20+ CSR TimedAction files, JeevesClaimsClient.lua, SaucedCarts Network.lua
entries.short_description: Send command from client to server
entries.plain_english_meaning: Tell the server to do something - include only primitive data
entries.why_it_matters: ALL multiplayer state changes must use this pattern
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR uses 20+ sendClientCommand calls across timed actions
entries.notes: Always guard with if isClient() then. Args must be primitives only.

entries.short_description: Prevent double-patching vanilla functions
entries.plain_english_meaning: Check if we already modified this function before modifying it again
entries.why_it_matters: Without guards, patches stack infinitely on reload/re-init
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR uses this correctly in all monkey-patch files
entries.notes: Pattern: if ClassName.__flag then return end; ClassName.__flag = true

entries.short_description: Defer vanilla function patching to OnGameStart
entries.plain_english_meaning: Wait until the game is loaded before modifying vanilla functions
entries.why_it_matters: Vanilla classes may not exist during file load phase
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR correctly defers all patches. Previous bug: vanilla requires at top broke loading.
entries.notes: CSR had a major bug (ReturnValues.put NPE) from doing this wrong before

entries.method_or_pattern_name: pcall for unstable Java API calls
entries.short_description: Wrap potentially failing Java method calls in pcall
entries.plain_english_meaning: Try calling a method that might crash and handle the error gracefully
entries.why_it_matters: B42 APIs can change between versions; pcall prevents total crashes
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has 20+ pcall sites, especially in Standpipe and Utils
entries.notes: pcall CANNOT catch Java NPEs. Only catches Lua errors. Guard Java NPE-prone calls with nil checks.
entries.example_snippet_summary: local ok, val = pcall(function() return obj:getFluidAmount() end)

entries.short_description: Check execution context before using context-specific APIs
entries.plain_english_meaning: Make sure we're on the right side (client or server) before doing something
entries.why_it_matters: Moodles don't exist on server, sendClientCommand crashes in SP
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has 15+ isServer/isClient guards
entries.notes: Shared code must check context. Server files: if not isServer() then return end at top.
entries.example_snippet_summary: if not isServer() then local panic = moodles:getMoodleLevel(MoodleType.Panic) end

entries.short_description: Validate player distance before processing server commands
entries.plain_english_meaning: Check that the player is actually near the thing they claim to interact with
entries.why_it_matters: Prevents remote exploitation in MP (cheating)
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has isNearPlayer() with MAX_WORLD_INTERACT_DISTANCE check
entries.notes: Also check Z level (±1 floor). CSR does this correctly.
entries.example_snippet_summary: if player:DistToSquared(x, y) > MAX_DIST * MAX_DIST then return end

entries.short_description: Add context menu option with rich tooltip showing success chances
entries.plain_english_meaning: Show a menu option with colored tooltip showing tool info and success chance
entries.why_it_matters: Better UX than plain text options
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR could benefit from tooltips on pry/lockpick options
entries.notes: Uses RGB color codes in description string
entries.example_snippet_summary: local tt = ISToolTip:new(); tt.description = '<RGB:0.8,1,0.8> 75%'; opt.toolTip = tt

entries.short_description: Create or retrieve persistent data that survives server restarts
entries.plain_english_meaning: Get a save slot for mod data that persists across sessions
entries.why_it_matters: Missing from CSR - could explain state loss on restart
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR does NOT use this - may need it for standpipe/knowledge state
entries.notes: Server-side persistence. Use Events.OnInitGlobalModData to initialize.

entries.short_description: Per-player persistent data storage
entries.plain_english_meaning: Save data to a specific player that persists across sessions
entries.why_it_matters: Per-player settings/state survive disconnects
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR could use this for seatbelt state instead of runtime vars
entries.notes: Restored on Events.OnCreatePlayer

entries.short_description: Search adjacent squares for target objects
entries.plain_english_meaning: Look at the clicked square and all 8 neighbors to find the target object
entries.why_it_matters: Workaround for B42 sprite detection failures on multi-tile objects
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR may need this for garage door pry detection
entries.notes: B41 holdover but still needed in B42 for some sprite types
entries.example_snippet_summary: for dx=-1,1 do for dy=-1,1 do local sq = cell:getGridSquare(x+dx,y+dy,z) ... end end

entries.short_description: Store only primitives in timed action constructors for MP safety
entries.plain_english_meaning: Only save numbers and strings in the action - look up actual objects when needed
entries.why_it_matters: Object references can become invalid between action queuing and execution in MP
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR stores some object references in actions - potential MP issue
entries.notes: Re-resolve objects in isValid()/perform() from stored coordinates
entries.example_snippet_summary: o.squareX = sq:getX(); o.squareY = sq:getY(); -- NOT o.square = sq

entries.short_description: Validate types of client-supplied arguments on server
entries.plain_english_meaning: Check that coordinates are actually numbers before using them
entries.why_it_matters: Prevents server crashes from malformed client data
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR_ServerCommands LACKS this validation - RISKY
entries.notes: Add: if type(args.x) ~= 'number' then return end
entries.example_snippet_summary: if type(args.x) ~= 'number' or type(args.y) ~= 'number' then return end

entries.short_description: Create custom UI panel by deriving from ISPanel
entries.plain_english_meaning: Make a new window/panel class for custom mod UI
entries.why_it_matters: Standard way to add mod UI that integrates with PZ's UI system
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has 3 custom panels that use this correctly
entries.notes: Client-only. Always call ISPanel.initialise(self) in initialise().

entries.short_description: Centralized feature gating via sandbox options
entries.plain_english_meaning: Every feature can be turned on/off via server settings
entries.why_it_matters: Allows server admins to disable problematic features without removing the mod
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR has 25+ feature flags - strong architecture
entries.notes: Always check with fallback: sandbox().Flag or defaultValue
entries.example_snippet_summary: function CSR_FeatureFlags.isPryEnabled() return sandbox().EnablePrySystem == true end

entries.short_description: Compatibility patch that disables conflicting features in other mods
entries.plain_english_meaning: Turn off a feature in another mod to prevent conflict
entries.why_it_matters: Shows how other mods handle CSR/CommonSense conflicts
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR should be aware that CleanHotBar patches its sandbox vars
entries.notes: CleanHotBar sets SandboxVars.CommonSense.GunStats = false on OnGameStart
entries.example_snippet_summary: if SandboxVars.CommonSense then SandboxVars.CommonSense.GunStats = false end

entries.short_description: Series of pcall-wrapped calls to B42 fluid container API
entries.plain_english_meaning: Carefully try each plumbing operation, catching failures at each step
entries.why_it_matters: B42 fluid API is unstable and changes between minor versions
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR standpipe system depends entirely on these APIs
entries.notes: Compare with WaterPipes mod approach and PlumbWorkaround for alternatives
entries.example_snippet_summary: local ok, amt = pcall(function() return obj:getFluidAmount() end)

entries.short_description: Fix for pcall-wrapped ISTimedActionQueue.add corrupting Kahlua on B42.15
entries.plain_english_meaning: Wrapping action queue in pcall causes Java errors to corrupt the scripting engine
entries.why_it_matters: pcall cannot safely catch Java RuntimeExceptions in Kahlua
entries.relevance_to_current_project: CSR should NEVER pcall-wrap ISTimedActionQueue.add
entries.notes: Java NPEs propagate through pcall and corrupt call frame state

entries.method_or_pattern_name: getFileWriter returns nil on invalid initialization
entries.short_description: Latest patch makes incorrectly initialized file writers return nil/null.
entries.plain_english_meaning: Do not call :write or :close unless the writer exists.
entries.why_it_matters: Log helpers that assumed a writer always existed can now crash the mod.
entries.notes: MCP space_audit_runtime_risks now warns on writer usage without a nearby nil guard.
entries.example_snippet_summary: local w = getFileWriter(name, true, false); if not w then return end; w:write(msg); w:close()
